rules.title: Bill to prohibit algorithmic rent setting (S.2983)
rules.requirement: This is a proposed Massachusetts bill to stop landlords from using algorithms to set or fix rents. It is not law yet; it was sent to the Ways and Means committee.
rules.requirement_es: Este es un proyecto de ley propuesto en Massachusetts para impedir que los arrendadores usen algoritmos para fijar las rentas. Todavía no es ley; fue enviado al comité de Medios y Arbitrios.
rules.coverage_text: Pending bill; reported favorably by the Joint Committee on Housing on 3/12/2026 and referred to Ways and Means. Bill text is not included on this page.
rules.quote: An Act prohibiting algorithmic rent setting
